# @loom/analytics

Event-intelligence for Loom — pure read-only analyzers and an advisory runtime-intelligence report over the durable event log (execution / cost / reasoning / failure). A lens on the log, never a writer.

## Entry points

- `@loom/analytics`

## Install

Unpublished for now: inside this repo use `workspace:*`; from a sibling checkout use a `link:` override (see [AGENTS.md](../../AGENTS.md)).
